title: Verticalized Upgrade Messaging & QBR Templates
body:
Goal: a compact, repeatable set of QBR slides and one-pagers that CSMs + Solutions can use to: surface upgrade signals, quantify infra economics for Dedicated/Private, and drive premium SLA conversations. This is intentionally operational and modular — pick the vertical module + technical appendix for the account.

1) Verticalized one-pager (pick one):
- SaaS / Platform: focus on predictable throughput needs (peak hour throughput, p95 latency), tagging: multi-tenant cost leakage, burst patterns. 
- FinServ: emphasize private+KMS, audit trails, compliance SLAs, data residency, and dedicated capacity for predictable trading windows. 
- Health / Regulated: regulatory controls, air-gapped packaging option, SOC/ISO attachments, and private deployment timelines.

Each one-pager sections: 
- Snapshot: 3 metrics (30d tokens, p95 latency, 1-week peak RPS)
- Trigger insight: what event should push upgrade (e.g., >2x peak week over baseline, >10% error spikes tied to batch jobs)
- Technical ask: dedicated GPU pool size estimate + shared vs dedicated cost delta (example calc)
- Business ask: recommended contract amendment (monthly reserved v. burst credits)

2) QBR slide script (3 slides, 8–12 minute cadence):
- Slide A: Health & usage highlights (safety: SLOs met, latency P95, token growth) — call out model variant mix and cost/unit.
- Slide B: Risk & friction map (hot routes, error bursts, tail latencies), show incidents with RCA and mitigations.
- Slide C: Opportunity & proposal — present concrete uplift offer: Dedicated baseline + 10% burst, or Private PoC w/ 3-month pilot + security add-on. Include expected unit cost delta and customer-facing ROI in dollars.

3) Renewal/Expansion tracker snippet (table-style text for copy into sheet):
- Account | Primary Contact | Trigger (usage/event) | Proposed Path | Est. ARR uplift | Owner | Next action | ETA
- AcmeCorp | VP Eng (R. Kim) | 3x monthly peak | Dedicated-4g (reserved) + SLA silver | $72k/yr | Marta | Technical deep dive 2/27 | 2026-03-15

4) Technical appendix (for SEs):
- Sizing rules of thumb: baseline throughput = avg tokens/sec * concurrent requests. Add 30% headroom for KV cache misses. For autoregressive text gen, assume 12–16 tokens/sec per A100-equivalent (quantized).
- Quick calc example: 200 RPS at avg 64 tokens/request -> 12.8k tokens/sec -> ~800k tokens/min. If customer needs <100ms p95, recommend dedicated with distributed KV and batching disabled for tail-sensitive routes.

5) Outreach templates (short):
- Email subject: "Quick QBR + cost optimization idea for [Account]"
- Body: "Hi [Name], we saw consistent peak-week traffic that would be a great fit for Dedicated — can we run a 60-minute technical + business review? I have a short plan showing expected cost/unit improvements and an optional SLA add-on. -- Jordan"

6) CSM call playbook (script highlights):
- Opening: 60s recap of usage trend and business impact.
- Technical handover: invite SE to speak for 5 minutes on latency/capacity options.
- Close: propose: 30-day reserved pilot (non-disruptive) + optional 'premium SLA' play (4-hour incident response, quarterly architecture review). Ask for agreement on success metrics.

7) Success metrics for a pilot: 
- SLOs: p95 latency target, 99.9% availability for routed endpoints, max error rate <0.5%
- Economics: target >15% reduction in per-token cost or predictability improvements that justify contract.

Notes / open items (to iterate):
- Need standardized pricing table for Dedicated tiers (ESTIMATE only) and template legal language for SLA attachment.
- Add a short A/B sales script: "cheaper with Dedicated when you hit sustained baseline X tokens/day" vs "Private when compliance is non-negotiable".
- Request Priya to pull 6 demo accounts for vertical-specific screenshots.

Quick checklist before a QBR/expand pitch:
- [ ] Confirm metric sources (console vs. customer telemetry)
- [ ] Run cost delta calc and 3-year TCO paragraph
- [ ] Sync legal on SLA terms we can offer in pilot
- [ ] Prepare SE runbook for the 60-minute technical session

Use this doc as the single-file playbook for the initial outreach + 1-pager + QBR script. Follow-ups: convert to a shared slide deck (3-slide template + appendix) and add to Confluence upgrade signals page.
